title: Vera Cruz Tomatoes
description: A creamy bacon, spinach, and cheese filling turns ordinary tomatoes into a terrific appetizer, side dish, or light entree.

steps.text: Preheat an oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Grease an 8x8 inch baking dish.
Cut tops from tomatoes; remove seeds and membranes. Place tomato shells upside down on paper towels to drain until filling.

Place the bacon in a large, deep skillet, and cook over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain the bacon slices on a paper towel-lined plate, reserve drippings. Crumble bacon and set aside. Return 2 tablespoons of drippings to skillet.

Cook onion in the bacon drippings until tender, about 5 minutes. Stir in spinach; cook and stir until wilted, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in sour cream, reserved crumbled bacon, and hot pepper sauce.
Sprinkle tomato shells with salt; fill evenly with bacon and spinach mixture. Place tomatoes in prepared baking dish.
Bake in preheated oven until hot, 20 to 25 minutes. Remove, and top evenly with the shredded cheese. Return to the oven; bake until cheese is melted, about 5 minutes.

video.description: Tomato, tomato! 🍅 It's peak tomato season, and whether you're plucking them from your garden or scooping them up at the farmers market, these recipes are the perfect excuse to indulge in summer’s sweetest fruit. In this video, Nicole shares five easy, summer-ready tomato recipes that are juicy, delicious, and bursting with flavor. She kicks things off with a twist on a Southern summer classic: tomato pie dip. Then it's time for a tomato bacon jam—perfect for burgers, sandwiches and charcuterie boards. Next up: her best shakshuka, followed by a bright and zesty Brazilian tomato slaw (Vinagrete). She wraps it up with a simple yet satisfying cheesy stuffed tomato: Vera Cruz tomatoes.
